jobs.title: Creative Director, Brand & Campaign
jobs.description:
At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound.

Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation.

Job Description

We’re looking for a Creative Director, Brand & Campaigns to define and evolve how Bose looks, feels and shows up in the world.

This role will be responsible for defining Bose’s visual identity, establishing a distinctive and consistent brand expression across product launches, campaigns, experiences, and cultural activations. The Creative Director will lead the creative concepting and development of Bose’s most important product photography and video content, translating product innovation, design and new color collections into compelling creative that builds desire and strengthens the brand.

Beyond product launches, this person will guide how the Bose identity is applied across every major brand expression—from live experiences, events and partnership activations to talent seeding, packaging and physical environments. They will also lead the development of advertising and experiential work that brings Bose’s broader brand platform to life in culturally relevant and emotionally resonant ways.

The ideal candidate is a concept-driven creative leader with a sophisticated visual point of view, deep experience in product and brand storytelling, and the ability to move fluidly between defining creative systems and producing breakthrough work. They combine exceptional taste with strong leadership, translating a clear brand vision into work that is both highly distinctive and consistently executed.

What You’ll Do

Define Bose’s Visual Identity

Own and evolve Bose’s global visual identity, establishing the creative principles, design language and visual systems that define how the brand shows up.
Create a clear and differentiated point of view across photography, film, motion, graphic design, typography, color, composition and art direction.
Develop and maintain brand creative guidelines that give internal teams and external partners a strong framework without limiting creative ambition.
Ensure the Bose brand is recognizable, coherent and elevated across every consumer touchpoint.

Lead Product Photography and Video

Lead the creative concepting, art direction and production of Bose’s global product photography and video content.
Define the visual stories for major product launches, seasonal moments and new color collections.
Translate product design, technology and innovation into work that creates emotional desire—not simply functional understanding.
Select and direct photographers, directors, designers, stylists and production partners to deliver work at the highest creative standard.

Serve as the Creative North Star Across Brand Design

Set the creative direction for how Bose’s brand identity is applied across experiences, partnerships, events, retail environments, talent seeding and physical brand expressions.
Guide the design of seeding kits, packaging, installations, event environments and partnership activations to ensure they feel unmistakably Bose.
Provide senior creative leadership and clear decision-making across internal teams, agencies and external collaborators.
Establish a consistent standard of craft while allowing each execution to respond authentically to its audience, partner and cultural context.

Bring the Bose Brand Platform to Life

Lead the development of video, experiential and integrated creative work that builds and expresses Bose’s overarching brand platform.
Translate the brand strategy into compelling concepts, narratives and consumer experiences.
Develop work that demonstrates the emotional and cultural power of sound while reinforcing Bose’s authority in audio.
Identify new creative formats and opportunities to bring the platform to life across film, content, live experiences and cultural moments.
Ensure product storytelling and brand storytelling work together as one connected creative system.

Build and Inspire Creative Teams

Lead, mentor and develop multidisciplinary teams across art direction, design and creative development.
Create a culture of high standards, constructive critique, experimentation and creative ambition.
Build strong relationships across Brand, Product, Partnerships, Experiential, Communications and Marketing.
Represent a clear creative point of view with senior leaders, agency partners and external collaborators.

At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of New York, New York is: $180,900-$248,775.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary. In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. Join us and make your next career move a mic-drop. Let’s Make Waves.

‎

jobs.title: Creative Director, Art and Design
jobs.description:
Who We Are

With offices in Newport Beach, New York, Toronto and Montréal, Passport Brand Design, part of WPP, is rapidly putting itself on the map as a trusted brand partner. We’re passionate about offering creative leadership to global businesses seeking direction on high-level brand strategy, evergreen and seasonal campaigns, and creative executions across all touch points. Our holistic approach to brand identity begins by creating a strategic positioning and brand purpose, which is then translated into a core creative idea that has the power to align teams and guide a fully integrated marketing process. We are looking for people who love what they do, who want to stay inspired and inspire others, who want to do great work and work with great people.

About WPP

Passport is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.

Who We Are Looking For

Passport Brand Design, a VML company and part of the WPP network, is seeking a forward-thinking Creative Director of Art & Design to lead a talented, large-scale team of art directors and designers. As a globally respected premium brand agency, we rely on this senior leadership role to drive conceptual and design excellence across brand identity, packaging, and campaign design.

As part of the WPP network, Passport Brand Design is committed to a Human First approach. You will bring this to life by deeply investing in the growth of your team, helping them translate technological and creative capabilities into meaningful, high-impact outcomes for our clients.

Please note
: This role primarily supports creative work within the tobacco industry. We share this upfront to ensure transparency and alignment with your personal preferences and comfort level.

What You'll Do

Lead and Inspire: Mentor, manage, and empower a team of art directors, designers, and copywriters, fostering a culture of creative excellence that elevates the agency's overall output.
Drive Creative Vision: Own the creative direction and execution across multiple simultaneous accounts, delivering premium brand identity, packaging, and integrated campaign designs that drive measurable brand growth.
Present with Confidence: Articulate and defend creative concepts to executive-level clients with clarity, conviction, and strategic grounding to build trust and consensus.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with strategy, account management, and production teams to ensure all work is strategically sound, flawlessly executed, and aligned with business objectives.
Embrace Constraints: Navigate the nuances of a highly regulated industry, using parameters as a catalyst to deliver innovative, compliant, and standout creative solutions.
Champion Standards: Act as a steward of the agency's premium design standards, ensuring consistency, craft, and quality across all deliverables.
Execute Conceptually: Lead the creation of strong conceptual campaigns across print, out-of-home, digital, experiential, and activations to build cohesive brand experiences.

Who You Are

A strategic, curious problem-solver who can distill complex category rules into elegant, compelling design systems.
An empathetic leader who builds trust, champions collaboration, and creates an inclusive space for creatives to do their best work.
A bold idea-driver who is comfortable with ambiguity and has the conviction to push for exceptional, high-impact work, even within regulated spaces.

What You'll Need

Proven Creative Director experience within an agency environment, with a demonstrated ability to orchestrate and manage creative workflows.
A compelling, high-caliber portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft in brand identity, packaging, and campaign design.
A proven track record of managing, mentoring, and developing large creative teams.
Exceptional client-facing skills, including experience presenting to and aligning with C-suite stakeholders.
Comfort and willingness to work on tobacco industry accounts.
Willingness and ability to accommodate occasional required travel.

The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is indicated below. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, click WPP Benefits for more details.

_: $100,000 USD - $230,000 USD

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP (Passport Brand Design) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. jobs.title: Senior Creative Lead (Freelancer)
jobs.description:
About the Role:
At WITHIN, we champion growth, innovation, and forward-thinking creativity. Now, we're looking for a Senior Creative Lead who embodies this ethos: a talented, multidisciplinary creative who can ideate, design, and craft our clients’ digital narratives. Boasting several years of experience in the realm of digital content creation with a strong digital ad portfolio, you know what it takes to grow brands through exciting, engaging, and beautiful content. We’re looking for someone that’s interested in pushing the boundaries to work in a lean structure and help grow both our clients as well as our team.

Key Responsibilities

Performance-Focused Content Creation: Craft content with intent. From ideation to execution, you’ll be charged with weaving out clients’ visual identity, voice, and ethos into groundbreaking content, pushing engagement and metrics beyond set KPIs.
Multifaceted Ideation and Creative Development: You’ll brainstorm, concept, plan, produce, edit, and write copy for content within a lean structure to bring ideas to life.
Trend Analysis & Application: Vigilantly monitor the digital sphere. Absorb emerging social trends, ensuring our content remains at the front of relevance and innovation. When a trend surfaces, you're already brainstorming how to adapt it to our unique brand narrative.
Detail-Oriented Post-Production & Delivery: Ensure each content piece undergoes rigorous post-production process & QA. From video edits, image selection, retouching to quality checks, every detail matters.
Operational Mastery: Command multiple projects. Adhere to tight schedules, and ensure an iterative approach, valuing feedback and refining accordingly.

Essential Qualifications

Solid Track Record: 5-6 years experience, creating and producing paid and organic social content. Your portfolio should echo your proficiency.
Technical Prowess: Deep knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, Photoshop, After Effects), Figma, and Capcut. Photo+Video Camera operations, audio recording nuances, and lighting techniques should be second nature to you.
Strong Design Capabilities: Strong digital design portfolio, encompassing static and motion design across digital ad placements and campaigns
Studio Proficiency: Over 3+ years planning/running in-studio shoots. This entails everything from setting up the perfect shot to ensuring the lighting captures our clients’ energy.
Intuitive Insights: A holistic grasp of the social media landscape is crucial. This entails understanding not just the emerging trends but the undercurrents shaping them.
Versatility: Equally adept at team-based and solo projects. The ability to pivot between collaboration and independent endeavors is crucial.
Rapid Adaptability: A dynamic environment isn't a challenge but an opportunity. This role demands proactive problem-solving and an innate drive.
Excellent Communication Skills: The ability to communicate well with clients and internal stakeholders is a must.
Production Budget Management: Ability to bid, forecast, keep a running total, and reconcile wrapped budgets for your shoots is a must.

Nice-to-haves

Generative AI Experience: Proficiency in Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, ChatGPT a plus
Retouching: Photo retouching a plus
Styling & Set/Prop Design: Experience with wardrobe selection & curation, set design, prop selection and styling
Food & Beverage Production: Experience generating content for food & beverage brands, particularly alcohol & spirits, that’s awesome.
Fashion/Retail Production: Experience generating content for retail and/or fashion brands definitely a plus as well.

We offer a competitive rate based on education, experience, and skills level ($22-$95)

Level 1 - Possesses essential capabilities.

Level 2 - $36-$51
Level 2 - Possesses developing capabilities.

Level 3 - $51-$66
Level 3 - Possesses notable capabilities.

Level 4 - $66-$81
Level 4 - Possesses strong capabilities.

Level 5 - $81-$95

As this is a freelancer role, hours can fluctuate weekly.

About WITHIN

WITHIN
is the world's first Performance Branding company, partnering with some of the biggest brands in the world to drive business growth through innovative marketing strategies. Our integrated operating model collapses the traditional marketing silos between creative and media, performance and brand, and across media channels. With a full suite of offerings including media, creative, SEO, Lifecycle, Retail Media, Affiliate and Influencer, we’re able to work with our brand partners in an integrated fashion, allowing us to align marketing strategies back to core business objectives. Client teams at WITHIN are trained on how to always act as a trusted business partner, acting as a fiduciary to client needs above our own.

Teams at WITHIN have the ability to work with iconic brands such as The North Face, Timberland, Ben and Jerry's and Jose Cuervo. Everyone at WITHIN wants to grow and be challenged. It’s a collaborative place made up of small, closely knit and versatile teams that are fast and adaptive to solve problems and build systems.

Check out some of our work

We weave AI into everything we do
, using the latest tech across all teams to innovate, work smarter, and make better decisions. Whether it’s in creative, operations, or anything else, AI helps us level up and do things at a whole new scale. We expect our people to use AI in their daily work, fully embracing it as a critical tool to help us succeed.

Join Our Network!

Stay connected with us and be the first to know about new opportunities, industry insights, and updates.

jobs.title: Creative Operations - Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Bully Pulpit International is an outcomes agency made up of strategists, data scientists, and artists. We come from politics, brands, and government and we communicate without barriers and measure what matters. We have more than 400 team members in six countries and thirteen offices — Berlin, Brussels, Chicago, D.C., London, Los Angeles, New York, Oslo, San Francisco, and Zürich. We apply our unique expertise across strategic communications, public affairs, research, and digital marketing to create sophisticated and customized strategies that make change possible for both American and European clients.

The Impact You Will Make

The Creative Operations Senior Manager at BPI plays a critical role in supporting the day-to-day operations of the Creative department, helping ensure our teams have the right people, processes, information, and support to deliver their best work. Reporting to the Senior Director of Creative Operations, this role helps connect the dots across creative workflows, resourcing, scopes, budgets, timelines, and overall project health.

You'll partner closely with Creative leadership and teams across Client Services,, Production, Resource Management, Finance, and Operations to keep work moving efficiently, identify needs and risks early, and continually improve how Creative works across BPI.

Starting Salary Range: $90,000 - $100,000 (+ annual bonus)
Expectation to work from one of our offices (Chicago, DC, NYC, SF, LA) at least 3 days a week

What The Day-to-Day Looks Like

Manage and maintain the day-to-day creative resource tracker, ensuring allocations, availability, project assignments, and upcoming needs are accurate and up to date
Partner with Creative Operations and Creative leadership to support staffing across projects, helping match the right people and skill sets to the right briefs
Work closely with Account, Strategy, Production, and project leads to understand upcoming work, timelines, staffing requirements, and changes in project needs
Monitor creative capacity and utilization, identifying potential conflicts, gaps, or periods of over- and under-allocation and flagging them early
Lead weekly resource and staffing meetings by gathering information, maintaining accurate allocations, and following up on agreed staffing changes
Help coordinate freelance resource needs, including identifying when additional support may be required, tracking availability, and supporting onboarding and extensions
Build an understanding of the creative team — their skills, experience, interests, development goals, and availability — to help make thoughtful staffing recommendations
Keep teams informed of staffing changes and ensure Creative, Creative Operations, and project leads have clear visibility into who is working on what
Support forecasting of upcoming resource needs by looking ahead at the pipeline and helping identify where additional capacity or specific skill sets may be required
Help improve resource management tools, trackers, and ways of working, making it easier for teams to understand capacity and make informed staffing decisions

Requirements

What You Bring

5-7 years of experience in Creative Operations, Creative Services, project management, or a similar role within an agency or fast-paced creative environment
Strong experience partnering with Creative leadership and cross-functional teams to help manage the day-to-day operations of a busy creative department
Experience developing scopes of work, staffing plans, timelines, and estimates, with a strong understanding of how creative work gets delivered
Strong commercial and financial awareness, including tracking scopes, budgets, burn, freelance spend, and project health
Experience managing creative workflows and processes from brief through delivery, identifying gaps and helping teams work more efficiently
A strong understanding of creative resourcing, including balancing staff and freelance talent against project needs, timelines, and budgets
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and stakeholders at the same time
Confidence working closely with Creative, Account, Strategy, Production, Finance, and Resource Management teams
A people-first approach to operations — able to bring structure and accountability without creating unnecessary process
A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to spot potential issues early and help teams find practical ways forward
Experience with project management, resource management, and financial tracking tools, with an interest in continually improving how teams work

Benefits

BPI offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) program with employer match up to 4%, generous time off for vacation, $50 monthly phone reimbursement, unlimited sick time, and 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents
. BPI's benefits prioritize employee wellness and progressive support to our diverse workforce.

We're looking for all kinds of people.

BPI Group is an integrated public affairs agency that delivers outcomes for the top organizations and leaders around the world. With expertise in strategic communications, digital marketing, creative, research, and measurement, we offer a cohesive approach across corporate, policy, and public affairs strategy in today's interconnected world. By combining incisive strategy and deep tactical expertise, we make change possible. Our transatlantic presence includes offices across thirteen markets in the US and Europe.

We are an equal opportunity employer and make employment decisions based on individual commitment to excellence. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

BPI is dedicated to building an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible workplace that fosters a sense of belonging - so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to still consider submitting an application . We consider applications holistically and you may be just the right candidate for this role or another one of our openings!

Let's keep in touch. Follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter at bpigroup.com

jobs.title: Art Director (Temporary), Advancement Marketing Services
jobs.description:
About EAB

At EAB , our mission is to make education smarter and our communities stronger. We work with more than 2,800 institutions to drive transformative change through data-driven insights and best-in-class capabilities. From kindergarten to college to career, EAB partners with leaders and practitioners to accelerate progress and drive results across enrollment, student success, institutional strategy, data analytics, and advancement. We work with each partner differently, tailoring our portfolio of research, technology, and marketing and enrollment solutions to meet the unique needs of every leadership team, as well as the students and employees they serve.

At EAB, we serve not only our partner institutions but each other—that's why we are always working to make sure our employees love their jobs and are invested in their communities. See how we've been recognized for this dedication to our employees by checking out our recent awards .

For more information, visit our Careers page.

The Role In Brief

Art Director (Temporary), Advancement Marketing Services

The Art Director helps plan and execute the art, design and other visual elements of effective direct marketing materials for a portfolio of higher education clients, including direct mail, marketing collateral, digital/social media display ads, email, landing pages and various client support materials, while ensuring overall production quality and effectiveness. The position reports to the Associate Director, Art Direction and works primarily with other Art Directors. This role routinely works with client account teams, copywriters and digital marketing specialists and to create quality creative work that fulfills client goals and expectations.

This role may be based in Richmond or Washington, D.C. This is a temporary position expected to last 6 months.

Primary Responsibilities

Research and develop understanding of each assigned client (new and existing) including school history, annual fund objectives, current challenges, current messaging platform/pillars and brand/graphic assets for existing and newly assigned clients
Understand, embrace and integrate clients’ brand (graphics and otherwise) in order to create and execute art, design and other direct marketing materials (mail, freemiums, email, webpages, social media display ads and more) to meet client objectives
Optimize client response rates by creating effective marketing packages built on proven direct marketing principles, strategies and tactics
Build emails and landing pages using HTML and CSS following best practices to ensure optimal performance across all email clients, browsers, and devices
Work within our marketing automation platform to build email templates and web experiences
Work within our content management system (CMS) to format content and configure functionality
Collaborate with client account team members, copywriters and digital team to help create innovative campaigns and ultimately ensure quality and timeliness
Prioritize and deliver work per established deadlines
Maintain current and accurate files of creative reference materials for assigned clients
Participate in team, creative and staff meetings, specifically client discovery and rediscovery discussions

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a related field
2 years of work experience in marketing or advertising environment
Possesses and applies the fundamentals of design and production, including use of Adobe Creative Suite (Acrobat, Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop), the Macintosh operating system, Microsoft Word as well as a workflow/project management system
Knowledge of best practices designing and coding HTML emails
Knowledge of graphic optimization and web animation
Proven organizational skills and self-starter with ability to handle multiple priorities/deadlines in a fast-paced environment

Ideal Qualifications

Demonstrated ability to leverage direct marketing principles, think creatively and translate ideas into art, design, and other visual elements
Knowledge of and experience with web design and usability
Print production and postal regulations and guidelines
Animation and video design and execution, knowledge of Adobe After Effects, Adobe Premiere
A passion for design and the willingness to collaborate with and learn from other creative professionals
Effective communication, teamwork and problem-solving skills
Commitment to embracing a continual learning environment and contributing to a dynamic and welcoming culture of fairness, authenticity, and belonging in support of EAB’s mission, values, and aspiration.

If you’ve reached this section of the job description and are unsure of whether to apply, please do! At EAB, we welcome new perspectives and learn from each other’s unique experiences. We would encourage you to submit an application if this is a role you would be passionate about doing every day.

Compensation

The anticipated starting salary for this role is $25 per hour.

This opening is not eligible for visa sponsorship at this time; EAB will thus consider candidates who possess U.S. work authorization that does not require employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future.

At EAB, we believe that to fulfill our mission to “make education smarter and our communities stronger” we need team members who bring a diversity of perspectives to the table and are committed to fostering a workplace where each team member is valued, respected and heard.

To that end, EAB is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we make employment decisions on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

jobs.title: Orchard - Senior Art Director (Health)
jobs.description:
At Orchard, the future has always inspired us. As we imagine how people will connect, what they expect from brands, and where they'll turn for their essentials, we're driven by curiosity.

This curiosity pushes us to see brands not as single moments, but as a web of connected experiences. In an era where every touchpoint is an opportunity to delight and engage, we fuse creativity, data and technology to influence action across the entire customer journey.

Which is why, at Orchard, we rally around a single purpose: to invent better outcomes through creativity, data and technology. Those better outcomes can only exist in the context of people irrespective of if we label them users, customers, patients or clients.

Job Description

We’re looking for a Snr Art Director to drive ideas, craft excellence and creative direction across all channels while providing leadership within our creative team. Providing creative direction, ideation, problem-solving, mentoring and quality control to meet our clients’ requirements, we’re looking for an experienced manager of people- someone who will inspire others, taking our creative to new levels as we continue to grow. You must be extremely creative, dedicated and possess excellent written and verbal communication skills. You’ll be a hands-on design leader, spending most of your time creating (around 70%) and the rest (around 30%) mentoring and supporting the team.

This senior-level role, reporting to the Creative Director, balances design execution with creative leadership, elevating craft standards, enhancing ways of working, and owning day-to-day creative delivery. You can manage the design and execution of entire campaigns (not just the production of specific pieces) and demonstrate an ability to keep other team members working alongside you within established deadlines. You demonstrate a high level of proficiency in design software and applications as well as great knowledge of printing procedures, photography, illustration, 3D and structural. You’ll also play a key role in l
eading new business efforts, from contributing to standout creative ideas through to confidently presenting and delivering pitches.

Your work will span a diverse range of clients and categories: from brand identity and campaign rollouts to leave-behinds, animation storyboards, conference/event collateral, OOH, experiential, large format, POS, 3D, structural, sales aids, eDMs, and social content.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver best-in-class creative ideas and design across digital and print.
Execute solutions from concept to final delivery: typography, branding, campaign rollouts, leave-behinds, animation storyboards, and sales/educational collateral.
Develop assets for a wide range of touchpoints: social, eDMs, websites, conference/event materials, OOH, experiential, large format, POS, 3D and structural.
Lead and contribute to new business pitches with standout creative ideas, polished execution, and confident delivery.
Present and deliver design thinking in client presentations and internal forums, delivering irresistible presentations that showcase solutions and astound clients.
Decipher, question, and absorb briefs at client meetings, developing clear ideas with bulletproof rationales and knowing the client’s brand guidelines better than they do.
Serve as a key client-facing creative lead, building strong day-to-day relationships, attending status and briefing meetings, and confidently presenting creative work that earns trust and drives results.
Go the journey from initial mood boards and scamps, through to supporting the final execution. Live and breathe projects, big and small, approaching each challenge with passion, intelligence and humour.
Bring an inquisitive multi-channel mindset and a keen eye for the latest industry trends, helping push clients’ brands forward with big, ideas-led thinking.
Use Figma and Adobe Creative Suite to create, manage, and evolve design systems and collaborative workflows.
Embrace and champion AI tools and workflows as part of the creative process exploring how emerging technology can accelerate ideation, enhance output quality and open up new creative possibilities for the team and our clients.

Note on working arrangements

The role is expected to be remote; however, some travel to New Jersey, USA, may be required.
Availability to work 9am-5pm within the US East Coast time zone is essential
Candidates must have in-depth knowledge of US regulations, including FDA promotional regulations and the PhRMA Code on Interactions with Health Care Professionals

Qualifications

About You

8+ years’ experience in a similar Creative role, with a demonstrated track record of conceptualising and executing impactful, engaging creative across platforms. Experience in health/pharma essential.
Strong leadership and mentoring experience, able to support and inspire a creative team.
A portfolio of previous work that shows the ability to turn a concept into a finished execution—spanning digital, print, OOH, social, campaign, and pitch work.
Abundant experience designing for Print, Digital, 3D, Structural, Experiential, Social, Animation, large format, and POS across a wide range of deliverables, including typography, branding, campaign rollouts, leave-behinds, sales aids, animation storyboards, conference/event collateral, eDMs, and OOH.
Proven experience leading and delivering new business pitches with confidence.
Advanced fluency in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator) and Figma; Cinema 4D (or similar 3D software) highly regarded. Experience in Unreal, After Effects and/or Premiere is a strong advantage.
Extensive experience conceptualising and executing your own ideas within established brand guidelines, across campaign concepting, branding, production and multi-channel rollout.
A confident communicator who can inspire clients and colleagues alike.
A genuine curiosity about AI and its role in the future of creativity — comfortable experimenting with AI-assisted workflows and keen to help build a culture where the team uses these tools thoughtfully and to their full potential.
Passionate about ideas and the power of creativity to make real-world impact across any category. Background in retail marketing (online/in-store), OOH advertising, film/TV, gaming or consumer electronics a bonus.

Above all, the successful candidate to join Orchard will be someone who has a strong work ethic driven by creative passion, positive energy and thrives on challenges, alongside a desire to grow with the company!

new_jobs.title: Creative Director, Brand & Campaign
new_jobs.description:
At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound.

Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation.

Job Description

We’re looking for a Creative Director, Brand & Campaigns to define and evolve how Bose looks, feels and shows up in the world.

This role will be responsible for defining Bose’s visual identity, establishing a distinctive and consistent brand expression across product launches, campaigns, experiences, and cultural activations. The Creative Director will lead the creative concepting and development of Bose’s most important product photography and video content, translating product innovation, design and new color collections into compelling creative that builds desire and strengthens the brand.

Beyond product launches, this person will guide how the Bose identity is applied across every major brand expression—from live experiences, events and partnership activations to talent seeding, packaging and physical environments. They will also lead the development of advertising and experiential work that brings Bose’s broader brand platform to life in culturally relevant and emotionally resonant ways.

The ideal candidate is a concept-driven creative leader with a sophisticated visual point of view, deep experience in product and brand storytelling, and the ability to move fluidly between defining creative systems and producing breakthrough work. They combine exceptional taste with strong leadership, translating a clear brand vision into work that is both highly distinctive and consistently executed.

What You’ll Do

Define Bose’s Visual Identity

Own and evolve Bose’s global visual identity, establishing the creative principles, design language and visual systems that define how the brand shows up.
Create a clear and differentiated point of view across photography, film, motion, graphic design, typography, color, composition and art direction.
Develop and maintain brand creative guidelines that give internal teams and external partners a strong framework without limiting creative ambition.
Ensure the Bose brand is recognizable, coherent and elevated across every consumer touchpoint.

Lead Product Photography and Video

Lead the creative concepting, art direction and production of Bose’s global product photography and video content.
Define the visual stories for major product launches, seasonal moments and new color collections.
Translate product design, technology and innovation into work that creates emotional desire—not simply functional understanding.
Select and direct photographers, directors, designers, stylists and production partners to deliver work at the highest creative standard.

Serve as the Creative North Star Across Brand Design

Set the creative direction for how Bose’s brand identity is applied across experiences, partnerships, events, retail environments, talent seeding and physical brand expressions.
Guide the design of seeding kits, packaging, installations, event environments and partnership activations to ensure they feel unmistakably Bose.
Provide senior creative leadership and clear decision-making across internal teams, agencies and external collaborators.
Establish a consistent standard of craft while allowing each execution to respond authentically to its audience, partner and cultural context.

Bring the Bose Brand Platform to Life

Lead the development of video, experiential and integrated creative work that builds and expresses Bose’s overarching brand platform.
Translate the brand strategy into compelling concepts, narratives and consumer experiences.
Develop work that demonstrates the emotional and cultural power of sound while reinforcing Bose’s authority in audio.
Identify new creative formats and opportunities to bring the platform to life across film, content, live experiences and cultural moments.
Ensure product storytelling and brand storytelling work together as one connected creative system.

Build and Inspire Creative Teams

Lead, mentor and develop multidisciplinary teams across art direction, design and creative development.
Create a culture of high standards, constructive critique, experimentation and creative ambition.
Build strong relationships across Brand, Product, Partnerships, Experiential, Communications and Marketing.
Represent a clear creative point of view with senior leaders, agency partners and external collaborators.

At Bose, you're inspired to be and do your best and are rewarded for your unique talents! Our compensation is thoughtfully tailored to your skills, experience, education, and location, and goes beyond base salary. The hiring range for this position in the primary work location of New York, New York is: $180,900-$248,775.The hiring range for other Bose work locations may vary. In addition to competitive base pay we offer rewards including bonus programs, comprehensive health and welfare benefits, a 401(k) plan, plus exclusive perks designed to support your wellbeing, and a generous employee discount where you can immerse yourself in our products and experiences. We are a proudly independent company—driven by purpose, guided by our values, and united by a belief in the power of sound. As the world leader in audio experiences, we’re creating what’s next—pushing boundaries and delivering transformative sound experiences for people everywhere. Join us and make your next career move a mic-drop. Let’s Make Waves.

About the Role:
At WITHIN, we champion growth, innovation, and forward-thinking creativity. Now, we're looking for a Senior Creative Lead who embodies this ethos: a talented, multidisciplinary creative who can ideate, design, and craft our clients’ digital narratives. Boasting several years of experience in the realm of digital content creation with a strong digital ad portfolio, you know what it takes to grow brands through exciting, engaging, and beautiful content. We’re looking for someone that’s interested in pushing the boundaries to work in a lean structure and help grow both our clients as well as our team.

Key Responsibilities

Performance-Focused Content Creation: Craft content with intent. From ideation to execution, you’ll be charged with weaving out clients’ visual identity, voice, and ethos into groundbreaking content, pushing engagement and metrics beyond set KPIs.
Multifaceted Ideation and Creative Development: You’ll brainstorm, concept, plan, produce, edit, and write copy for content within a lean structure to bring ideas to life.
Trend Analysis & Application: Vigilantly monitor the digital sphere. Absorb emerging social trends, ensuring our content remains at the front of relevance and innovation. When a trend surfaces, you're already brainstorming how to adapt it to our unique brand narrative.
Detail-Oriented Post-Production & Delivery: Ensure each content piece undergoes rigorous post-production process & QA. From video edits, image selection, retouching to quality checks, every detail matters.
Operational Mastery: Command multiple projects. Adhere to tight schedules, and ensure an iterative approach, valuing feedback and refining accordingly.

Solid Track Record: 5-6 years experience, creating and producing paid and organic social content. Your portfolio should echo your proficiency.
Technical Prowess: Deep knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, Photoshop, After Effects), Figma, and Capcut. Photo+Video Camera operations, audio recording nuances, and lighting techniques should be second nature to you.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Creative Operations, this role helps connect the dots across creative workflows, resourcing, scopes, budgets, timelines, and overall project health.

You'll partner closely with Creative leadership and teams across Client Services,, Production, Resource Management, Finance, and Operations to keep work moving efficiently, identify needs and risks early, and continually improve how Creative works across BPI.

5-7 years of experience in Creative Operations, Creative Services, project management, or a similar role within an agency or fast-paced creative environment

Experience developing scopes of work, staffing plans, timelines, and estimates, with a strong understanding of how creative work gets delivered
Strong commercial and financial awareness, including tracking scopes, budgets, burn, freelance spend, and project health
Experience managing creative workflows and processes from brief through delivery, identifying gaps and helping teams work more efficiently

Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and stakeholders at the same time
Confidence working closely with Creative, Account, Strategy, Production, Finance, and Resource Management teams

eading new business efforts, from contributing to standout creative ideas through to confidently presenting and delivering pitches.

Deliver best-in-class creative ideas and design across digital and print.
Execute solutions from concept to final delivery: typography, branding, campaign rollouts, leave-behinds, animation storyboards, and sales/educational collateral.
Develop assets for a wide range of touchpoints: social, eDMs, websites, conference/event materials, OOH, experiential, large format, POS, 3D and structural.

Bring an inquisitive multi-channel mindset and a keen eye for the latest industry trends, helping push clients’ brands forward with big, ideas-led thinking.

Embrace and champion AI tools and workflows as part of the creative process exploring how emerging technology can accelerate ideation, enhance output quality and open up new creative possibilities for the team and our clients.

Note on working arrangements

The role is expected to be remote; however, some travel to New Jersey, USA, may be required.
Availability to work 9am-5pm within the US East Coast time zone is essential
Candidates must have in-depth knowledge of US regulations, including FDA promotional regulations and the PhRMA Code on Interactions with Health Care Professionals

Qualifications

About You

8+ years’ experience in a similar Creative role, with a demonstrated track record of conceptualising and executing impactful, engaging creative across platforms. Experience in health/pharma essential.
Strong leadership and mentoring experience, able to support and inspire a creative team.
A portfolio of previous work that shows the ability to turn a concept into a finished execution—spanning digital, print, OOH, social, campaign, and pitch work.
Abundant experience designing for Print, Digital, 3D, Structural, Experiential, Social, Animation, large format, and POS across a wide range of deliverables, including typography, branding, campaign rollouts, leave-behinds, sales aids, animation storyboards, conference/event collateral, eDMs, and OOH.
Proven experience leading and delivering new business pitches with confidence.
Advanced fluency in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator) and Figma; Cinema 4D (or similar 3D software) highly regarded. Experience in Unreal, After Effects and/or Premiere is a strong advantage.
